visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A computer monitor is visible, displaying a 3D animated girl character with a large orange beanie, brown bob-cut hair, and blushing pink cheeks on a white background. A hand enters the frame and points toward the screen. (2) The scene cuts to a simplified version of the character with large black dot eyes and a flatter art style. A mouse cursor is seen hovering over the character image on the 'Gemini' AI interface. (3) The screen displays a text prompt being typed into the AI chat box, asking for a more 'mature' version. The lighting is bright office light reflecting on the glossy monitor surface. (4) A new generated image appears showing the character with significantly aged features, including deep wrinkles around the eyes and mouth, though still wearing the same orange hat. (5) The camera zooms in on another text prompt requesting the facial contour to be elongated. (6) The final result is displayed: the character now has an extremely long, crescent-shaped chin, creating a comedic effect. The person behind the camera shifts slightly, causing reflections on the monitor glass.
